findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 13 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 17 questions numbered 1-17; by section: u-introduction 1, 13.2 1, 13.3 1, 13.4 1, 13.5 1, 13.6 2, 13.7 1, 13.8 2, 13.9 2, 13.10 3, 13.11 2.

12 theory questions (physical properties, volatility and London forces, X-X bond energies and the fluorine anomaly, displacement reactions and E°, reactions with hydrogen, X-X versus H-X bond trends, reducing power of halide ions, silver nitrate/ammonia test, halides with concentrated H₂SO₄, balancing the hot-NaOH disproportionation, disinfection by HOCl/OCl⁻, factors affecting disinfection) and 5 numericals (H-X bond energy, AgCl and NH₃, HBr with H₂SO₄, chlorine with cold and hot NaOH) with atomic masses not in the chapter stated in the question, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: chlorine is a gas, F₂ + 2X⁻ → 2F⁻ + X₂, Ag⁺ + X⁻ → AgX, 2HBr(g) + H₂SO₄ → Br₂ + SO₂ + 2H₂O, 8HI(g), 3Cl₂ + 6NaOH → 5NaCl + NaClO₃ + 3H₂O, Cl 0 → -1.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
